$comment: Houdini Atlas — SOP Data Foundations starter pack node plan. This is a plan, not a hip file. Build it by hand inside a Geometry SOP in Houdini.

nodes.name: grid1
nodes.rationale: Predictable point + primitive count. 400 pts / 361 prims is easy to verify on the spreadsheet.

nodes.name: wr_height
nodes.rationale: Add @height. First place the spreadsheet acquires a non-default float attribute.

nodes.name: wr_color
nodes.rationale: Visualise @height on @Cd so the viewport encodes the data row, not magic colour.

nodes.name: promote_pt_to_prim_avg
nodes.rationale: Demonstrates point->prim with averaging — proves attribute lives on primitive class now.

nodes.name: promote_prim_to_pt_max
nodes.rationale: Demonstrates prim->point with maximum — visible stair-stepping at island borders.

nodes.name: OUT_data_view
nodes.rationale: First named OUT. The 'raw data' branch — points with original wrangle output.

nodes.name: OUT_render_ready
nodes.rationale: Second named OUT. The 'promoted twice' branch — for downstream comparisons.

notes: @ptnum is a row index on the Points tab — not a stable id.
@primnum is a row index on the Primitives tab — same caveat.
After promote->average, the @height column on the Primitives tab is smoother than the original.

honesty: Parameter names in your Houdini build may differ slightly across versions. Treat any mismatch as part of the learning, not an error in this plan.
